prompt: Create one complete horizontal 16:9 medieval leaded STAINED-GLASS artwork, one coherent scene. The ENTIRE image must be made of translucent colored glass pieces separated by clearly visible dark lead cames: faces, hands, robes, objects, terrain and sky. Lead seams cross inside faces along forehead, brows, nose bridge, cheekbones and jaw; 10-16 facial panes, not smooth painted skin inside a stained-glass border. Believable natural anatomy and subtle expression, not cartoon, not photorealistic painting. Jewel-toned handmade glass, uneven texture, directional transmitted light with readable shadows. Environment and figures one continuous perspective, no comic panels or webpage cards. Keep key faces, hands and props within central 80% of image. No text, no lettering, no readable runes, no watermark, no logos, no crosses or unrelated religious imagery.  Theme subtitle for semantic guidance ONLY, do not draw words: 更大的责任没有消除旧的责任. Single moment on Alcaz Island: Thrall in simple worn brown shaman robe and large red prayer beads, green skin, blue eyes and black braids, struggles behind a curved translucent WIND barrier against Jaina's overwhelming magical force. Jaina is a human mage with predominantly white hair and one golden-blonde streak, blue-white robes, wounded anger rather than villainous glee, on the opposing side with a luminous arcane orb representing the Focusing Iris nearby. Storm sea mass suspended behind her, city NOT flooded. Wind is represented by pale curved glass ribbons; no ordinary solid wall. Both faces readable and separated, Thrall straining, not overpowering her. No embrace, no handshake, no final victory, no other characters. Deep cobalt glass, violet and pale sea-green; restrained red accents.
